Second Nature | Staff Software Engineer (Engineering AI Team), Staff Software Engineer, Senior Software Engineer, Engineering Manager | REMOTE (US) | Full-time

Second Nature (https://secondnature.com) is redefining professional property management with fully managed Resident Benefits Packages. We're a Resident Experience Platform helping 1,000+ property management companies automate resident onboarding, credit-building, renters insurance, utilities, and other resident services, creating "Triple Win" experiences for residents, property managers, and investors.

We're the only 7-time national NARPM vendor of the year!

Tech Stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS. CI/CD with GitHub Actions. Domain-driven design and event-driven architecture.

Culture: We move fast ("Pirate Ship, Not a Cruise Ship"), take extreme ownership, and focus on outcomes. We're investing heavily in AI across our product and workflows, including a dedicated AI team.

Benefits: 100% remote (US), medical/dental/vision, 401K, open PTO, equity.

Open Roles:

Staff Software Engineer, Engineering AI Team ($150K-$180K) - High-agency IC building agentic AI dev workflows; the team ships 100% of its software with AI coding agents like Claude Code.
